speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
text: The Ministry of National Development (MND) will continue to build an endearing city to live, work and play.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
text: Business nodes and workplaces will be revitalised, bringing jobs closer to homes.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
text: The northern, eastern, and western gateways will grow as important economic nodes, while the city centre will remain a vital destination for business, tourism and culture, anchoring Singapore’s status as a global hub.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
text: We will continue to improve public rental housing, including upgrading older rental blocks and supporting more rental households to own their homes.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
text: We will also maintain a strong supply of land for private housing.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
text: Selected private housing estates will also benefit from senior-friendly enhancements, under the Estate Upgrading Programme (EUP) (Regular Estate) and the EUP (Silver Estate).

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
text: We will review legislation to ensure Management Corporations maintain and upgrade their ageing developments to meet the needs of their residents.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
text: Eligible households with seniors living in private properties will also get support to install in-home senior-friendly fittings under the Enhancement for Active Seniors (Private) programme.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
text: We are expanding the network of parks and park connectors to make green spaces more accessible and planning new public spaces along Identity Corridors that anchor community activity.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
text: MND will mitigate the impact of climate change on Singaporeans through measures such as climate-sensitive urban planning and building design and the use of cool paints to mitigate the impact of rising temperatures.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
text: MND will work with industry partners to uplift the built environment (BE) sector and to offer more career opportunities for Singaporeans.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
text: We will continue to empower BE firms to embrace technologies such as artificial intelligence tools, automation and digital collaboration across the building lifecycle.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
text: MND will work with industry partners to catalyse new growth opportunities.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
text: This includes empowering commercial property owners to undertake place management through the Business Improvement District initiative and partnering local companies to develop innovative products and solutions, which can benefit the BE sector in Singapore and abroad.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
text: Together with all Singaporeans, MND will shape a vibrant and sustainable future for our city – one that every generation can take pride in calling home.
